labels.FACT: Historical record (GE15 Baseline, state election results).
labels.MODEL: Modelled estimate — provisional constants, not a forecast.

caveat: Two constants in the Swing Model were set by judgement, not fitted to data. Treat every figure here as a direction, not a forecast. Every Seat's call is arithmetic against its GE15 result under a state-uniform swing, never a bespoke judgement about that constituency.
